Overview of MSc Biostatistics Curriculum and Module Integration

Overview

This section provides an overview of the MSc Biostatistics programme structure and explains how the Biostatistical Consulting & Collaboration module integrates with and builds upon other modules in the curriculum.

MSc Biostatistics Programme Structure

The MSc Biostatistics programme at Stellenbosch University is designed to provide both theoretical foundations and practical skills for a career in biostatistics.
